# Kick UI

> Kick UI is an open-source collection of animated React and Web3 UI components. Components use Tailwind CSS and Motion and can be installed as source code through the shadcn CLI.

## Start here

- [Component catalog](https://www.kickui.xyz/components): Browse components and live previews.
- [CLI installation guide](https://www.kickui.xyz/docs/cli): Install components through the shadcn CLI.
- [Next.js setup](https://www.kickui.xyz/docs/nextjs): Set up a compatible Next.js project.
- [Tailwind CSS setup](https://www.kickui.xyz/docs/tailwind-css): Add the required styles and tokens.
- [Shared utilities](https://www.kickui.xyz/docs/utilities): Add helpers used by components.

## Component examples

- [Trading Chart](https://www.kickui.xyz/components/trading-chart): Candlestick chart with volume, timeframes, and drawing tools.
- [Deposit Modal](https://www.kickui.xyz/components/deposit-modal): Deposit address interface with network and expiry states.
- [Venue Selector](https://www.kickui.xyz/components/venue-selector): Multi-venue selection interface.
- [Pill Button](https://www.kickui.xyz/components/pill-button): Animated glass-style button.
- [Scramble Text](https://www.kickui.xyz/components/scramble-text): Hover-driven text animation.

## Source and registry

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Shivam-Prajapati-59/Kick-UI): Source code, license, and contribution details.
- [Registry index](https://www.kickui.xyz/r/registry.json): Available registry items.
